items.text: Roundcube 1.6.19
maximum message size can now be set up to 2 GB; nginx and php-fpm limits follow that setting instead of staying at 100 MB, so large attachments finally reach webmail
Let's encrypt: renewal is due once less than a third of the certificate lifetime is left, and the CA's own renewal info (ARI) overrides that when available

Let's encrypt: fix renewals that took the slow path - valid authorizations are no longer re-challenged, the order is polled instead of re-POSTed, badNonce is retried, and the certificate download has a timeout
Let's encrypt: the issuing log is no longer deleted by the run that writes it
Let's encrypt: a failed renewal alerts after three attempts in a row, not the first
Let's encrypt: new certificates use P-256 keys and the private key is written with 0600
remote monitoring: the health endpoint answers 200 even when a check is critical, so a monitoring system reads the body instead of a transport error
remote monitoring: the heartbeat is sent at a fixed offset from the start of the measurement
remote monitoring: every stage of a heartbeat run is traced
administration moved from Bootstrap 3 to Bootstrap 5
console entrypoints drop to the mail user when started as root, so they stop leaving root-owned logs and caches behind
fix nginx rate limiting putting every public client into one shared bucket
remote monitoring: authenticated read-only health API and metrics
remote monitoring: optional outbound heartbeat posting
security: add CSRF protection to state-changing log/dkim/filter/quarantine actions
security: enforce log tenant scoping structurally, not via query string
security: require current password for self-service password change
security: sandbox BIMI logo SVG to prevent stored XSS
security: enforce ownership check on box/domain quota endpoints
rate limit requests and block common scanner paths to prevent server overload
advise to create virtual domain of hostname of mailserver and create DKIM
fix header_storage.js helper
fix admin bruteforce policy
fix daily cron noise about disabled mailboxes (doveadm -A now skips them)
fix Elasticsearch date handling in connection and transaction logs
